verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces, or spam complaints, and nothing on honoring suppression across broadcasts, sequences, and transactional sends. Adjacent items such as filtering by unsubscribe time, broadcast exclusive_tags, and visitor anonymization are different capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints are suppressed automatically and honored across every send type — CAN-SPAM/GDPR hygiene by default
